messages:
sarah.p: Quick preflight — we need a compact checklist for connector conformance + marketplace metadata. Target: gate for GA is conformance pass + signed sample attestation.

mike_engine: I can drive the CI shape. Proposal: two pipelines — smoke (trimmed samples) and nightly full-run (stage). Smoke runs on PRs, nightly runs on staging. Keep smoke under 30m.

raj.k: Sample packs: Snowflake (csv/parquet tiers), Databricks (parquet + simple stream), Qdrant (vectors). We should version packs like v1.0-scrubbed.

anna_partner: Partners will provide scrubbed packs with a provenance.txt and SHA256. We will not accept samples without an attestation. Can legal sign off on the attestation template?

sarah.p: I'll sync with legal after this thread. Marketplace metadata needs: short description, tested matrix, icons, support contact, entitlements. We should also add a short "limitations" note (e.g., supported dims, max row size).

mike_engine: For connector packaging: docker images for Dedicated/Private, wheels/pip for hosted. CI should exercise both packaging flows. Also add a matrix axis for python 3.9/3.10 and spark compatibility.

jess_ops: Ops note: add a throttled onboarding window for new marketplace listings to avoid traffic spikes. We should include a rollback toggle and a capacity playbook (scale Dedicated pool, reduce concurrency).

raj.k: Testing checklist idea: checksum validation, schema conformance, ingest smoke (row counts), query correctness (small query set with expected hit rates), and durability checks for streams.

anna_partner: Add an accessibility check for marketplace entries — alt text for images and short plain-language description. Marketing will want a one-line tagline we can reuse.

mike_engine: Vector tests: include dim-negotiation tests and mismatched-dim behavior. Decision: fail-fast on dim mismatch and surface remediation steps in logs.

sarah.p: Agreed on fail-fast. Also, include a short operational doc for partners: how to reproduce the CI local smoke and how to interpret failure codes.

jess_ops: We need to cap test egress on CI. Use 10% trimmed packs for PRs; full packs only on nightly stage runs with cost center tagging.

raj.k: Field pilot plan: 3 SI partners, 4 pilot customers. Provide an onboarding script and short runbook. We'll collect telemetry (ingest rate, query latency, error rates) and a small feedback survey.

mike_engine: Action items:
- mike_engine: implement CI matrix + verify_sample_pack.sh
- raj.k: produce sample packs v1.0 + query sets
- anna_partner: coordinate attestations and partner comms
- jess_ops: write onboarding throttle + rollback playbook
- sarah.p: produce marketplace metadata template & limitations text

sarah.p: Timeline: smoke CI + trimmed packs by Thu, nightly stage full by Sat, pilot invites Mon. I'll open the runbook PR and link it here when ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/connector-runbook (WIP)

deploy-bot: Pipeline "connector/smoke/snowflake" started by mike_engine

mike_engine: Quick question for the thread — do we want a "redwood-verified" badge only after both CI and a successful pilot, or after CI + signed attestation? I prefer pilot + CI for the badge.

anna_partner: Pilot + CI seems right. Badge should reflect real-world validation, not just lab runs.

sarah.p: OK — badge requires CI pass + pilot signoff + attestation. I'll include that in the metadata template. Thanks, team :rocket:
